item.title: Update: Trump says he "made the deal" on Huang
item.description:
Trump says he convinced Nvidia's board to reinstate Jensen Huang, and Republican senators have joined Democrats in criticizing the move. Van Hollen called it "exhibit A" of corruption in Trump's AI policy, and Warren told the Globe she wants a congressional investigation. The Guardian estimates Trump made up to $15 million on his Nvidia holdings. Semafor reports Vance played a hands-on role while Rubio, who once flagged counterintelligence risks, stays mum. Fox highlights critics calling it "socialism, communism," and Axios calls it a de facto bailout of the AI industry. Huang testifies next week.

Also: Guardian · Semafor · Fox News · Axios · Boston Globe (paywall)

item.description:

Prosecutors sought the warrant Oct. 2 for alleged violations "occurring between 1980 to the present," and Homeland Security Investigations, which handles immigration-fraud cases, carried it out Oct. 12. Politico reports DOJ says the House's top lawyer "refused to be involved."
